title: 烬·四朵纸花
description: 戴白色单眼面具的烬穿完整戏服，仔细摆放四朵纸花，武器关闭收存一旁。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Jhin is a slender adult masked performer with a smooth asymmetrical white theatrical mask, a single dark eye opening, flowing cream cloth, burgundy accents, and refined armored costume panels. Preserve his long elegant silhouette with fully covering sleeves, gloves, opaque trousers, and boots. His ornate firearm is closed and secured in a background display case, never held or aimed.
art_direction.scene: He sits at a small backstage table and arranges exactly four simple paper flowers in a low vase, carefully turning the final blossom. A folded plain curtain and one unlit stage lamp suggest theater without copying any performance scene. The pose is calm and meticulous, with rounded friendly shapes, no threatening shadows, and no writing.
art_direction.palette: ivory mask, burgundy, muted gold, dusty rose
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
